source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第七节

textbook_summary: Downward-scooped ST depression, initially negative then narrow upright terminal T and shortened QT; digitalis effect is not a toxicity inference.
limitations: One fixed contour and electrode vector, not a digitized patient ECG
No drug dose, concentration, toxicity or arrhythmia model
Other drug effects and rhythm combinations remain open

qrs_st_join.method: Offline exact-rational monotone Hermite from original sampled R peak through shoulder to original ST trough; shared nonzero shoulder derivative, zero derivatives at peak/trough. Preserve V1-V3 original projected composite. Reconstruct zero-sum limb electrodes; preserve limb identities. 512 samples at0.625ms; original terminal ST-T after150ms.
qrs_st_join.reason: Original terminal S recovery plus additive ST depression produced rebound, not continuous fish-hook descent.
qrs_st_join.limits: Authored selected-lead illustration, not every digitalis ECG or a dose-response model.
